floorPlans.label: Emaar: Ovelle complete villa floor plans
floorPlans.introduction: Compare four-bedroom, five-bedroom Medium and five-bedroom Premium villas. Each complete sheet shows ground, first and second floors together, plus the original area table, key plan and developer notices. The Medium wording follows the plan document.
floorPlans.note: Built-up area includes suite, parking, balcony and entrance/terrace components; it is not plot area or internal suite area alone. Displayed BUA follows each original printed total; sums of the listed components differ by up to 0.02 sq ft. Confirm the contractual unit drawing and pool, lift and landscaping inclusions. These are Ovelle plans; Avelia remains a separate release.
